description: Audit a whole stack at once. Provide a list of products (optionally with versions) — e.g. parsed from a package.json or Dockerfile — and get an EOL Risk Score for each, so you can see what is unsupported and dangerous in one call. For CycloneDX or SPDX documents use check_sbom instead. Without a key: up to 5 items per call; Starter 25; Pro 50. Items beyond the limit are listed as not checked, with a note.

items.description: List of stack components to score.

version.description: Optional version/cycle. Omit for highest-risk release.

name: scan_stack
title: Scan a stack
